stage: Design and requirements; application implementation has not started
purpose: Learning web application with simulated devices, generated data and manual inputs
revision: Shared rooftop PV, automatic home-only battery backup, selectable simulated weather and day/night

temperatureUnits.scope: Global preference across dashboard, controls, scheduler, charts, tooltips and reports
temperatureUnits.persistence: User preference, or browser preference for an anonymous demo

rooftopSolarPV.charges: Home storage battery from surplus PV
rooftopSolarPV.visual: Solar panels on the house roof only; no panels or canopy over the car

solarWaterHeater.visual: Horizontal tank above inclined evacuated tubes

triggers: Household demand exceeds available rooftop solar power
Cloud-reduced solar causing a household supply deficit
homeBattery.controlRule: Respond to current power availability and home demand, rather than fixed time windows or cloud labels alone
userVisibleData: Charge or discharge power in kW

grid.automaticHomeFallback: Configurable proposal; only used when explicitly enabled

home.autoMeaning: Use rooftop solar for the home and automatically cover any home deficit from the battery within limits

ev.solarSource: Same rooftop PV installation as the home

simulationEnvironmentControls.location: Dashboard header, next to the global temperature-unit switch

weather.interaction: Click the current weather badge to open a dropdown
weather.visual: Weather icon, selected label and dropdown chevron; selected menu item has a checkmark

lighting.independence: Weather and day/night are separate inputs; preserve the chosen weather when switching Day/Night

behavior.day: Weather modifies simulated available sunlight and rooftop PV output
behavior.night: PV output and incoming solar thermal heat are zero for every weather choice
behavior.battery: Automatically supply only the home's actual solar deficit, respecting reserve, power limits and available stored energy
behavior.preserveState: Changing weather or day/night does not reset battery energy, EV charge, water temperature, schedules or existing history
behavior.continuity: Power readings respond on the next simulation step; stored energy, charge percentage and water temperature evolve over simulated time
behavior.history: Append the new readings and log environment-control changes; do not rewrite past readings
behavior.clock: These controls force environmental conditions. They do not silently change or rewind the simulation clock; schedule evaluation continues against that explicit clock.
behavior.persistence: Keep the settings within each visitor's isolated demo session

allocationPriority: Serve the home's demand from rooftop solar
If solar is insufficient for the home, use the home battery within reserve and power limits
Allow EV solar charging only from remaining rooftop PV; never discharge the home battery to cover EV demand
Charge the home battery with PV surplus after selected loads
Export remaining PV surplus only when enabled; otherwise curtail
proposedSimulationRules.autoHomePowerEquation: batteryOutput = min(max(0, homeDemand - solarAllocatedToHome), allowedDischargePower, energyAvailableAboveReserve / timestepHours)
proposedSimulationRules.nightBehavior: Solar availability becomes zero; Auto mode uses battery for home demand subject to its limits
proposedSimulationRules.cloudyBehavior: Cloud conditions reduce simulated PV availability; discharge occurs only when the home has an actual solar deficit
batteryBehavior: Respect charge/discharge power limits and minimum reserve
Do not charge and discharge simultaneously
Never use battery output for the EV, water backup or grid
proposedSimulationRules.lowBatteryBehavior: Use grid only if configured fallback is enabled; otherwise show the home's unmet load or limited supply
proposedSimulationRules.scheduling: Battery operation has no scheduled source blocks or charging/discharging windows. Smart Scheduler controls EV charging and water backup; home Auto responds continuously to current conditions.
proposedSimulationRules.temperatureBehavior: Changing display units does not change stored physical values
proposedSimulationRules.waterOffBehavior: Disables powered backup heating; passive thermal collection and heat loss continue
proposedSimulationRules.reproducibility: Repeatable simulation clock and random seed; calculate analytics from saved readings
proposedSimulationRules.weatherInput: Dashboard dropdown: Sunny, Cloudy or Rainy. Dashboard Day/Night toggle independently forces the daylight condition; no live weather API is needed.
scenarios: Sunny: rooftop PV supplies home and EV, surplus charges home battery
Cloudy: battery covers home shortfall; EV in Solar mode pauses or reduces charging
Night: battery powers home; EV uses grid only if selected or scheduled
Battery reserve reached: configured grid fallback or limited home supply
Cloudy but sufficient PV: battery stays idle or charges
Click weather dropdown and switch Sunny / Cloudy / Rainy while preserving battery state
Switch to Night under any weather: solar becomes zero and home automatic backup responds
Switch to Day and Sunny: PV rises and surplus can charge the home battery

illustrativeWeatherPresets.disclaimer: Configurable simulation examples, not weather forecasts or engineering predictions
illustrativeWeatherPresets.batteryCondition: Examples assume sufficient stored energy above reserve and adequate discharge power

illustrativeDashboardSnapshot.disclaimer: Simulation example values, not hardware specifications
illustrativeDashboardSnapshot.balance: 1.2 kW rooftop solar + 1.4 kW battery output = 2.6 kW home demand; EV charging and water electric backup draw zero

pageIntegration.dashboard: Remove car PV canopy, show rooftop PV shared by home and EV, rename shared battery to Home battery, show automatic home-only discharge and reason, replace home battery schedule preview with automatic supply status; clickable Sunny/Cloudy/Rainy dropdown and separate Day/Night toggle in the header
pageIntegration.controlCenter: Home Auto/Grid/Off; no manual Battery source button; battery status and reserve; remove Battery from EV and water controls; no car PV canopy
pageIntegration.smartScheduler: EV and water scheduling; no battery source blocks, no battery charge/discharge schedules; EV solar source is rooftop PV
pageIntegration.analytics: Separate home battery charge/discharge history, home and EV electrical loads, solar thermal output and water grid backup; retain global temperature units
pageIntegration.simulationLab: Weather presets and actual supply/demand conditions drive automatic battery behavior; EV never consumes home battery power; uses the same environment state as the dashboard selectors

designStatus.note: Earlier numbered images remain as historical concepts and may show superseded canopy and battery behavior
